Tamil Nadu Budget Focuses on Welfare, AI, and Industry

Tamil Nadu's government presented its maiden budget, with announcements including the 'Vetri Laptop Scheme' and AI governance initiatives. The budget allocates ₹23,357 crore to healthcare, though some educationists noted a drop in higher education funding. Industry leaders reportedly viewed the budget positively, emphasizing its focus on growth and industrial development. Meanwhile, former CM Stalin criticized the budget as a 'remake version' of previous schemes, while AIADMK chief Palaniswami rated it 'zero'. Separately, four individuals began an indefinite hunger strike against the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET).
